scope: Everything Goes: twelve normal Rooms per region, with Corridors excluded
source: User responses to ten design questions; threshold buffers and evidence gates are explicitly proposed analysis conventions, not user-selected rules.

assessment.method: 95% Wilson interval for proportions; 95% game-cluster bootstrap CI for per-room rates and maximum Hero spread; 95% CI over per-run per-fight means; no inference from CPU time
assessment.interventionRule: Escalate only when confidence interval entirely beyond action threshold; review when estimate breaches acceptable band; otherwise insufficient/inconclusive where CI crosses boundary.
assessment.secondary: matched Item experiments are separate and never pooled with organic balance targets

metrics.population: All organic solo expeditions, including early defeats
All organic two-Hero expeditions, including early defeats
Organic expeditions that enter all 36 non-Corridor regional Rooms
metrics.numerator: Ordinary printed regional Monster encounters, counting each physical monster entry
metrics.denominator: Number of fully traversed 36-Room organic runs

metrics.caveat: A Monster fight can have multiple turns; count the encounter-to-first-combat transition only once.

metrics.population: Organic runs with at least one ordinary Monster fight
metrics.numerator: HP actually lost during ordinary Monster contexts, including Item backfires while fighting
metrics.denominator: Ordinary fight starts times summed maximum HP of the party at run start
metrics.caveat: Combat-context damage is not asserted to be caused by the Monster; separate such causes in raw event tape.

metrics.numerator: Acquired physical Item cards, excluding starter resources, starting gifts and reacquisitions only if explicitly indicated

metrics.population: Organic regional normal Room exposures; early deaths included
metrics.numerator: Actual Item uses of specified odd dice/chaos cards
metrics.denominator: Total ordinary non-Corridor regional Room entries
metrics.caveat: Only actual activations count. Possession and unused trigger opportunities are measured separately.

metrics.population: Eight separate solo Hero cohorts in organic survey
metrics.numerator: Highest observed solo-Hero win rate minus lowest
metrics.denominator: Full completed runs per Hero, with at least 80 for each Hero

metrics.population: All printed Room outcomes that have two choices
metrics.numerator: Options validated by a deterministic executable action test

physicalTime.population: Human tabletop solo expedition, pauses removed
Human tabletop two-Hero expedition, pauses removed

itemAudit.focusedExecution: Every explicitly printed effect must have at least one deterministic test that enters its condition and validates an actual result; an organic simulation cannot replace an executable proof.
itemAudit.organicObservation: Every card appears in card-coverage.csv including zero-exposure cards. Compare acquired, held, equipped, legal opportunities, actual uses, passive triggers, and effect results.
itemAudit.zeroUseWithOpportunities: FLAG_FOR_INVESTIGATION - may reflect poor AI policy or contextual value; not automatically an engine defect
itemAudit.neverAppears: TARGETED_REACHABILITY_TEST_REQUIRED - sample absence alone is not proof that the card is impossible to obtain
itemAudit.matchedPairBaseline: Dry Rations (ex-rations), single extra starting physical copy for each arm; Red String requires a two-Hero party.
itemAudit.thresholdRule: Never label a zero-use Item unusable without checking printed trigger conditions and a focused legal-action / effect test.
